expect.cite: Kofu SCR 138 prints "(If you can't put 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck, you can't use this card.)": a printed condition, kept when the effect is used through Look-Alike Show (user decision D5; official JP FAQ, Fire Energy MEE 2 / Mela: the user of the effect must meet it); Kofu SCR 138: "If you put 2 cards on the bottom of your deck in this way, draw 4 cards."
